title: ViLBERT: Pretraining Task-Agnostic Visiolinguistic Representations for Vision-and-Language Tasks
layout_note: Two parallel streams in rows: visual (image regions v0..vT) on top, linguistic (tokens w0..wT) below; each goes Embed -> layers -> outputs h; the text stream has L-k extra TRM layers first, then a dashed k x block where Co-TRM layers cross-connect the streams with curved arrows.
grouping: Colour family per stream (green visual, purple linguistic); dashed rectangles mark the repeated blocks with their counts 'L-k x' and 'k x' printed underneath; inputs and outputs wrapped in large round brackets.
shapes_depth: Flat small rounded rectangles with a thin dark outline; Co-TRM boxes filled with a green-to-purple gradient to show they mix both streams; image regions as real photo thumbnails, words in monospace text.
proposed_highlight: The novel co-attention layers (Co-TRM) are the only boxes with a two-colour gradient fill and the only place where arrows cross between the streams, inside the 'k x' dashed block.
lesson: Mark a module that mixes two colour-coded streams with a gradient of both stream colours, and let the cross-stream arrows appear only at that module.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue NeurIPS 2019 (first page reads 'Preprint. Under review').

arrangement.units: two rows (visual on top, linguistic below) with no band or frame; the shared repeated block is one dashed rectangle spanning both rows, and a second dashed rectangle wraps the text-only layers
arrangement.inputs_as: a bracketed row of real image-region photos with and a bracketed row of words with /, each labelled v_i / w_i
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn (outputs h_v and h_w in brackets at the right)
arrangement.shared: the co-attention block is one dashed rectangle spanning both rows, with curved arrows crossing between them

taxonomy.task: vision-language pretraining with two co-attention streams

core.what: two parallel rows, the visual stream (image regions v0..vT) on top and the linguistic stream (tokens w0..wT) below, which exchange information only inside a dashed 'k x' block where Co-TRM boxes are cross-connected by curved arrows

relations.form: each row runs left to right: bracketed inputs -> Embed -> layers -> bracketed outputs h_v / h_w
two curved arrows cross between the rows into the Co-TRM boxes, the only cross-stream lines in the figure
dashed boxes with 'L-k x' (one extra TRM on the text row) and 'k x' (Co-TRM + TRM on both rows) mark repeated layers

channels.colour: green = visual stream, purple = linguistic stream; Co-TRM boxes carry a green-purple gradient, marking them as mixing both
channels.shape: rounded boxes are layers; real image crops and quoted words are the inputs; bracket glyphs group inputs and outputs
channels.line: straight arrows within a stream, curved arrows only for cross-stream attention
channels.frame: dashed frames mark repeated layer blocks with their repeat counts

quality.strengths: Stream identity is one colour per row and the co-attention module is the only two-colour box and the only place lines cross, so the contribution is visible as geometry; real image regions and a real sentence are the inputs; very compact with straight within-stream lines.
quality.weaknesses: The two curved cross arrows overlap each other inside the dashed block, so which output feeds which Co-TRM takes a second look; outputs h are typeset symbols only.

insights.structure: Two streams run as parallel rows (visual above, text below) and are tied together only by a dashed 'k x' rectangle spanning both rows that holds the Co-TRM and TRM layers.
insights.data: Image regions are real photo crops in a bracketed row labelled v0..vT and text is a bracketed monospace sentence labelled w0..wT; outputs are bracketed h vectors at the right.
insights.emphasis: Co-TRM boxes have a green-to-purple gradient fill, the only bi-coloured shapes, and are where the two curved crossing arrows land.
insights.flow: Both rows read left to right; the only non-horizontal lines are two curved arrows that cross in an X into the opposite stream's Co-TRM.
insights.avoid: The cross-stream arrows start from the Embed and TRM boxes before the block rather than inside it, so the exact exchange (keys/values) is not visible and needs the separate detail figure.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
